summary: Core pipeline is unified and instrumented for usage. Rate limiting, request IDs, and basic request logging added; auth, monitoring, and load testing remain outstanding.
recommendations: Introduce authentication (JWT or session) and tenant scoping for usage logs.
Persist request logs to centralized storage (ELK/Datadog) and add correlation IDs across services.
Add monitoring dashboards for latency, error rate, and token usage.
Add server-side validation for request payload sizes and content.
Add background queue for STT/TTS with retry and circuit breakers.
